title: Duplicate Numbers List
statement: Given an integer array nums, return all numbers that appear more than once.

What is the key operation? Identify the repeated action over the input.
What wording signals stand out? duplicates list, count numbers, frequency.
What is the brute force idea? Use extra loops or repeated checks.
What is the better/optimal idea? Use a clean dictionary solution.
What are the edge cases? Empty-like input, single values, duplicates, and boundaries.
What is the complexity? For most of these easy tasks, aim for O(n) time unless sorting is required.
How would I explain it in an interview? State the pattern, the key operation, and the complexity.
